<div class="card-body">
'''Beru Lars''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Beru Lars]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 97 (index 3891). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベルー・ラーズ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">オーウェン・ラーズと同じ場所にいるか、水耕ステーションの上にいる場合、没収値に＋２。相手のターンに、ロストデッキへ行った場合、次の自分のターンが終了するまで、ルークの戦闘力に＋３。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-beru-lars-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">オーウェン・ラーズの妻。ルーク・スカイウォーカーの保護者。ルークの帝国アカデミー入学を夫のオーウェンに進言する。ファームの水耕ステーションの管理をしている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Beru Lars.

'''Card text:''' Forfeit +2 when at the same location as [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]] or at [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]]. If she goes to the Lost Pile during your opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.

'''Lore:''' [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]]'s wife and [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]'s guardian. She urges her husband Owen to let Luke enter the Imperial Academy. She manages the farm's hydroponics station.
